stn_colonel_210.m: You lost every fight. I really did not expect such a poor performance from you.
r: They were far too strong, and they all fought in an unfair way.

stn_colonel_220.m: You won every fight! Very good! I have not enjoyed myself so much for a long time.

stn_colonel_230.m: I did not expect you to win against all of my fighters, but it's good to know that for sure. Thanks for trying it out.
r: If you have more for me, just call.

stn_colonel_250.m: Take this medallion as a token of my thanks.
r: Very kind of you. Oh, how nice! There is a tiny little lizard on it. It looks completely real, just like the lizard I fought against.

stn_colonel_260.m: Go now. I have to think.

stn_colonel_32.m: Would you like a cup of good southern blend?

r: Who are you and how do you know my name?

stn_colonel_36.m: *chuckles* Very clever. You should not trust strangers nowadays.
r: Who are you and how do you know my name?
Right. That's why I'm leaving now.

stn_colonel_38.m: You have not finished all the fights. So what are you doing here?

stn_colonel_40.m: Oh, I know many things. A good leader has to keep his eyes and ears open.
r: You command the undead soldiers down there?
You didn't answer my question. Who are you?

stn_colonel_42.m: No, do not worry. I have nothing to do with the undead here in the castle. I just find them interesting.
r: Do you have any idea what the undead are doing here?

stn_colonel_43.m: No. I expected Lord Berbane's men to be here. But these undead are a nice change.

stn_colonel_44.m: I am Colonel Lutarc, maybe you have already heard of me? No? Whatever.
r: May I ask what you are doing here?

stn_colonel_50.m: Isn't that obvious? I am enjoying my tea here. It is a splendid place. I really like it here.
r: You do have a nice view from here.
You drink tea while fighting is going on down there?

stn_colonel_52.m: Indeed. I come often to watch my warriors down there as they fight.

stn_colonel_62.m: It was nice to see how easily you killed the undead knight.
r: Oh that - a small thing for me...

stn_colonel_63.m: It was nice to see how easily you killed the undead soldier.
r: Oh that - a small thing for me...

stn_colonel_64.m: I'm always impressed when I see a good fighter at work.
r: Just tell me what you want from me.

stn_colonel_70.m: Now I am curious about how well you could handle a number of my better warriors. Would you like to try?
r: Sure. After I have finished my tea of course.
Why not? A little challenge is always good.
Maybe some other time. I have to leave now.

stn_colonel_74.m: This is really an excellent tea, right?

stn_colonel_75.m: I had not noticed that the cups are so big.

stn_colonel_77.m: We have all the time in the world. Do not hurry.

stn_colonel_79.m: The Colonel looks at you silently now.

stn_colonel_80.m: Good. Please go to the foot of this hill, right down there, by the gate.

stn_colonel_82.m: There I will have five of my more interesting fighters compete against you.

stn_colonel_84.m: One after the other of course...

stn_colonel_86.m: Go now. Show me what you can do.

stn_colonel.10: I talked to Colonel Lutarc. He proposed a competition with five of his best fighters.
stn_colonel.20: I accepted. The fight will be at the foot of the hill.
stn_colonel.121: The second opponent was a skeleton warrior.
stn_colonel.122: He was no match for me.
stn_colonel.123: I lost against a pile of bones!
stn_colonel.131: Mikhail came and asked me to come home.
stn_colonel.132: But no, it wasn't Mikhail - it was a poser. Not a strong enough one though.
stn_colonel.133: My own father attacked me? I lost this fight.
stn_colonel.141: Then a little dragon came forth.
stn_colonel.151: The fifth and last opponent came towards me: Bully.
stn_colonel.160: I have finished all the fights. I should climb back up to Colonel Lutarc.
stn_colonel.170: He was pretty disappointed with my poor score.
stn_colonel.171: He was pretty impressed with my excellent result.
stn_colonel.172: My result confirmed his relatively low expectations.
stn_colonel.190: Lutarc gave me a medallion as a present. There is a tiny little lizard on it, that looks completely real.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
